items.note: Still open on the corrected bytes at 939a04a5f866ad666a0a7849465a20d1f99d3969. Lines 223-224 and 273 now define a route-aware Vitest configuration: Standard selects scaffold plus increment 4, while Fast increment N selects scaffold plus increments 1 through N, and learners run plain npm test before completion. However, line 273 also requires the unchanged shipped starter, on every Fast route, to fail only the newest increment. For N greater than 1 that contradicts both the cumulative suite selection and the shipped starter's unimplemented earlier-increment TODOs: increments 1 through N-1 must also fail until completed. The declared authoring-gate expectation therefore remains impossible. Specify checkpoint state explicitly: the untouched shipped starter is checked only on its shipped Standard route (and separately against increment 1 as already required), while Fast route N is checked from private staged bytes with increments 1 through N-1 complete; then newest-only failure before increment N and cumulative success after it are testable without committing a solution.
